title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, designed to provide you with unparalleled insights and efficiency.

title: Elevated File Management for Your Content
summary: Take full control of your embedded files with new options to easily manage, download, and customize their display within the editor, creating a more dynamic and organized content experience.

title: Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to discover recently released features, what's launching next, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, more visually appealing, and draggable, making your workflow smoother than ever.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've refined our editor to make working together smoother and more intuitive, ensuring everyone stays connected and productive.

title: Enhanced Sharing and Collaboration
summary: We've made it easier to find and collaborate on shared items with others, ensuring all relevant content is readily accessible.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko's core technology is now open source, giving our users unprecedented control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's exciting future.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: We are adding comprehensive support for international languages to make Noeko accessible to users worldwide.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Fresh New Themes
summary: Discover a more vibrant and personalized experience with our beautifully redesigned existing themes and an exciting collection of brand-new visual styles.

title: Supercharge Your Constellation View
summary: Navigate your entire knowledge base and spark new ideas with powerful new filters, including tags, time windows, and shared connections, all within an intuitive, interactive experience.

title: Precision Search & Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and revisit specific knowledge sets by applying powerful filters and saving your most refined searches as personalized collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: Experience a seamless and intuitive way to connect and explore your thoughts with our new dynamic content displays, designed to enhance your note organization.

title: Noeko's Public Launch: Self-Hosted and Cloud Plans
summary: Get ready for Noeko's official public release, offering flexible self-hosting and convenient cloud plans with enhanced features for all users.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Experience a seamless and accurate start to your day with greetings that now precisely reflect your current time.

title: Efficiently Manage Items Directly from Lists
summary: Perform essential actions like unapplying tags, deleting, or viewing items directly from your lists, saving you time and streamlining your workflow.

title: Bring All Your Content Together
summary: Experience unmatched flexibility by importing a rich variety of content, such as YouTube videos, websites, and text, to centralize and interact with all your information seamlessly.
